trophies.guide: The Platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work the roadmap in order: story first, then side strands, then free-roam cleanup, and finish with the 100% checklist, because A Long Road is the last gate before this one.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies; the Platinum unlocks automatically. [1][2]
Save A Long Road (100% completion) for last — it is the longest grind of the set. [1][3]
Expect roughly 200 hours in total (PowerPyx rates the set 4/10; Push Square estimates about 250 hours). [1][7]

trophies.guide: The opening mission of Chapter 1. Play through Gone Fishing as the story directs you; the trophy pops when the mission ends. Nothing here can be missed, so just enjoy the introduction to Leonida.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end. [1][2]
Story trophy — it unlocks automatically and cannot be missed. [10]

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and this pops at the chapter's end. Before you leave Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude — it is the one thing in the whole game that may not come back.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Complete all Chapter 1 missions. [1][2]
Before the chapter ends, do the balcony meditation at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude). [1][3]
Keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 1 — there is no mission replay. [2]

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. From this chapter both Jason and Lucia are playable, which is what most of the free-roam trophies need — the last meditation, for example, only counts once both leads can reach the spot.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Complete all Chapter 2 missions. [1][2]
Both leads become playable here, opening most partner and free-roam trophies. [2][6]

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Keep a manual save from the start of the chapter: with no mission replay, a chapter-start save is your only way back if you want to redo anything.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Complete all Chapter 3 missions. [1][2]
Make a manual save at the start of each chapter — there is no mission replay. [2]

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the finale. Before you start the final mission, make a separate manual save — it is your safety net for the ending and for anything you want to revisit.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Complete all Chapter 4 missions. [1][2]
Make a manual save before the final mission. [2][3]

trophies.guide: The Gold for finishing the story. Complete the final mission and it pops at the credits. After the story, free roam stays open, so everything except the one Chapter 1 meditation can still be finished afterwards.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Complete the final mission. [1][2]
Free roam continues after the credits, so cleanup can wait until now. [2][6]

trophies.guide: A story-mission trophy: finish the mission Breakfast Run and it unlocks. Story trophies cannot be missed — they pop as you play the main path.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Play the story mission Breakfast Run to completion. [1][2]
Story trophy — unlocks automatically, cannot be missed. [10]

trophies.guide: A story-mission trophy: finish The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are story beats, so there is no special setup — follow the mission and the trophy follows.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Play the story mission The Cartel Heist to completion. [1][2]
Story trophy — unlocks automatically, cannot be missed. [10]

trophies.guide: A story-mission trophy: finish Child's Play. Like every story trophy it pops on completion and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Play the story mission Child's Play to completion. [1][2]
Story trophy — unlocks automatically, cannot be missed. [10]

trophies.guide: A story-mission trophy: finish Headliners. No preparation needed — it is awarded for completing the mission itself.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Play the story mission Headliners to completion. [1][2]
Story trophy — unlocks automatically, cannot be missed. [10]

trophies.guide: A story-mission trophy: finish the VCIA Takedown. It pops when the mission ends, like every other story trophy.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Play the story mission VCIA Takedown to completion. [1][2]
Story trophy — unlocks automatically, cannot be missed. [10]

trophies.guide: A story-mission trophy: finish Operation Savage Glory. Complete the mission and the trophy is yours.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Play the story mission Operation Savage Glory to completion. [1][2]
Story trophy — unlocks automatically, cannot be missed. [10]

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set: finish the game's 100% checklist of 35 tasks. The checklist only appears after the story, under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — and anything you already did during the story still counts. It is split roughly 45% story and tasks, 45% exploration and activities, 10% discovery. The big numbers: 300 of 397 stunts, 15 of 18 meditation spots, 15 of 18 card sets, 200 of 277 vehicles, 70 of 80 challenges. Nothing on the checklist itself is missable, since every requirement can be finished in free roam after the credits.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story first — the checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. [2][6]
Work the 35 tasks: story and tasks (45%), exploration and activities (45%), discovery (10%). [6]
Big counts: 300/397 stunts, 15/18 meditations, 15/18 card sets, 200/277 vehicles, 70/80 challenges. [6]
Nothing on the checklist is missable — all of it can be done in free roam after the story. [2][6]

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game. There are four kinds — 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps — and you can mix them freely. Flying under bridges is the quickest kind to farm. Note the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250 if you are chasing A Long Road. Track progress under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, or on the map under Exploration and Stunt Spots.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Complete any 250 of 397 stunts; the four kinds are 130 jumps, 202 under bridges, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps. [1][6]
Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest to repeat. [1]
Track them under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots. [1]
The 100% checklist needs 300 stunts, so keep going after this pops. [1][6]

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type in the game once. There are nine types to sample — racing, fishing, shooting range, drone racing, arcade games, bowling, golf-style pastimes and the rest of Leonida's distractions. You only need to try each one, not win or finish it, so dip into each and move on.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Try each of the 9 activity types once — you only need to start one, not win it. [1][2]
Sample them as you meet them: races, fishing, shooting range, drone races, arcade, bowling and more. [1][6]

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is a pure skill grind: learn each range's target pattern, steady your aim, and repeat the ones you miss until every challenge shows gold. There is no shortcut — gold in all 42 is the whole requirement.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Visit the Shooting Range and work through all 42 challenges. [1][2]
Gold every challenge — a silver or bronze does not count. [1][6]
Repeat missed challenges until all 42 show gold. [1]

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Drone races are a flying skill test: learn each course's gates, cut corners only where the course allows, and keep the drone steady through the tight turns. A win at every location is required, not just one win overall.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find the Top Fun drone races — 14 locations across Leonida. [1][2]
Win a race at each location; one win per location counts. [1][6]

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts — street, off-road, boat or air — as long as each win is a different race. Mix race types to keep it fresh, and reuse the fastest vehicle you own for each surface.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Win 20 different races across Leonida. [1][2]
Any race type counts; each win must be a different race. [1][6]

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are timing and patience: watch the line tension, reel steadily, and do not rush the catch. Cal is a story character you meet early, so this can be done in Chapter 1 — grab it while you are there.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Take a fishing challenge against Cal. [1][2]
Reel steadily and watch line tension — rushing loses the fish. [1][6]
Do it in Chapter 1 while Cal is around. [2]

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet, start any game, and play it through to the end. It is one of the easiest trophies in the set — a quick stop in Chapter 1 is all it takes.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Find an arcade cabinet and start any arcade game. [1][2]
Play it through to completion. [1][6]

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand to its end. Stranger strands are chains of missions for one character — follow Andy's jobs in order until his final mission, and this pops when that last one is done.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: Follow Andy's mission strand through each of his jobs. [1][2]
Complete his final mission. [1][10]

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand to its end. Work through Kenton's jobs in order; the trophy pops when his final mission is complete. The boat-accident name is a hint at the kind of job Kenton hands out.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Follow Kenton's mission strand through each of his jobs. [1][2]
Complete his final mission. [1][10]

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand to its end. Billy's jobs build to a last ride — follow the strand in order and complete his final mission.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: Follow Billy's mission strand through each of his jobs. [1][2]
Complete his final mission. [1][10]

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strands are the side-job chains for characters like Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret — finish a whole strand, not just one mission, and it counts. There are more than 8 strands in the state, so pick the ones you enjoy and finish them fully.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Find stranger mission strands across Leonida. [1][2]
Complete 8 full strands — a finished strand counts, a single mission does not. [1][6]
The individual final-mission trophies (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) each count toward this. [2]

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand to its end. Work through Randy's supply jobs in order until his final mission, and the trophy pops on completion.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Follow Randy's mission strand through each of his jobs. [1][2]
Complete his final mission. [1][10]

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand to its end. Follow Tyrone's jobs in order; his final mission closes the strand and the trophy.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: Follow Tyrone's mission strand through each of his jobs. [1][2]
Complete his final mission. [1][10]

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots at 10 locations. Meditating at a spot with both Jason and Lucia counts twice, so bring your partner. Track the counter under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. THE MISSABLE ONE: the first meditation is Lucia's, on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1, the morning after the mission Down to Earth — follow her from the kitchen and accept it. That offer is gone after Chapter 1. Whether the trophy strictly needs it is unconfirmed (the guides disagree), so do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. Note the disagreement: PowerPyx and GTABase count 18 spots for the trophy, while the 100% checklist only asks for 15 of 18 — both numbers are shown here, not chosen between.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: Chapter 1, morning after Down to Earth: find Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house, follow her to the balcony, accept the meditation. [1][3][6]
Keep a Chapter 1 manual save until this trophy pops — there is no mission replay. [2]
Meditate at the other spots with both Jason and Lucia; each spot then counts twice. [1][6]
The last spot needs both leads playable, which is possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. [6]
Track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. [1]
Sources disagree on the count: 18 for the trophy (PowerPyx, GTABase) vs 15 of 18 for the 100% checklist — do all 18. [1][6]

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand points you at one specific animal — follow his strand, track the animal where he says it roams, and take the shot cleanly. This is the hunting strand's payoff trophy.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Follow Bret's strand until he marks the unique animal. [1][2]
Hunt that animal where Bret says it roams. [1][10]

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 480 cards in 18 sets scattered across Leonida, so three full sets is a modest slice of the total — but a set only counts when every card in it is found. The 100% checklist wants 15 of 18 sets, so card hunting continues long after this pops.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Collect cards across Leonida — 480 cards in 18 sets. [6]
Complete any 3 full sets; a set counts only when every card in it is found. [1][2]
The 100% checklist needs 15 of 18 sets, so keep collecting. [6]

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the game's photo-sharing spot marker — open it at scenic and landmark spots across Leonida and tag the location. There are far more than 100 taggable spots, so work it into your exploration rather than grinding it in one sitting.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Open WAiNK It at a location and tag it. [1][2]
Repeat at 100 different locations across Leonida. [1][6]
Fold it into exploration — tag spots as you travel. [1]

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's small feats — stunts, shooting, driving and more — and they stack up naturally as you play. The 100% checklist wants 70 of 80, so 50 is just the halfway mark on the way to full completion.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Complete any 50 challenges across all types. [1][2]
Challenges stack up naturally while doing stunts, shooting and driving. [1][6]
The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80 challenges — keep going. [6]

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. Bring your partner, cause enough chaos to reach 4 stars, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear. Doing it with your partner along is the requirement — solo does not count.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Bring your partner along. [1][2]
Build a 4-star wanted level. [1][6]
Break line of sight and stay hidden until the wanted level clears. [1]

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level. The trick is the opposite of Hot Together: keep the heat the whole way. Plan a route of three nearby shops, rob each in turn, and do not let the wanted level drop between them.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Bring your partner. [1][2]
Rob a shop, then two more back-to-back. [1][6]
Keep your wanted level the whole way — if it drops, start the chain again. [1]

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new vehicle you get into or drive counts toward discovery, so this fills itself in as you travel Leonida and try new rides. The 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 vehicles, so keep hopping into anything new you see.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Get into or drive new vehicles — each new one counts. [1][2]
100 discoveries pop the trophy; the checklist wants 200 of 277. [6]

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Find a fight with a cluster of enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five before it ends. Pick a spot where enemies group up, and use a weapon that kills fast.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Find a fight with at least 5 enemies close together. [1][2]
Trigger Combat Focus and take down 5 before it ends. [1][6]

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — the airport. Get to Vice City International Airport, grab a plane, and take off without a schedule. It is one of the game's playful one-off trophies: reach the runway and leave on your own terms.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Go to VCIA (Vice City International Airport). [1][2]
Get into a plane and take off — an unscheduled departure. [1][10]

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — a tank trophy. Get into a Rhino tank and make it count: drive it, use it, and stir up the kind of trouble only a tank can. This is a hidden one-off, so expect it to pop from simply playing with the tank.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Get into a Rhino tank. [1][2]
Use it in the open world until the trophy pops. [1][10]

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. This is a stealth job: case the store, wait for a quiet moment, slip in, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. Being spotted fails it, so plan the approach and the exit before you go in.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Pick a jewelry store and watch its routine first. [1][2]
Rob it without being detected — being spotted fails the attempt. [1][6]
Plan your exit before you go in. [1]

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Bank vaults are the big robberies: get in, crack the vault, grab the take and get clear with the heat on you. Five successful vault jobs — each one escaped clean — earn the Silver.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Rob a bank vault and escape with the take. [1][2]
Repeat until 5 vaults are robbed and escaped. [1][6]
Plan each escape route before the job. [1]

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida — intercept one, stop it, crack it open and get away before the response arrives. A classic Blitz-style play, and the trophy's name says so.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Find an armored truck on its route. [1][2]
Stop it, rob it, and escape before the response arrives. [1][6]

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 areas of the state. Drive, fly and walk into every named area until the map is filled in. This is a natural companion to the collectible and stunt hunts: explore as you do everything else and the areas tick off one by one.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Travel into every named area of Leonida — 52 in total. [1][2]
Use the map to spot areas you have not visited yet. [1][6]
Fold it into other hunts: stunts, cards and WAiNK spots take you everywhere anyway. [1]

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang runs illegal operations somewhere in Leonida — hit one per gang, all nine, and the trophy pops. Learn each gang's turf, find their operation, and rob it.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Find an illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs. [1][2]
Rob one operation per gang — all nine are needed. [1][6]

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view. A small, charming one-off — no skill needed, just the right spot and the right drink.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Go to Ocean Beach. [1][2]
Order and enjoy a cocktail with the view. [1][10]

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive into a showroom, pick your car, and leave through the glass the way the old games taught you. The trophy is a nod to the series' history — do it big and do it once.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Drive into a vehicle showroom. [1][2]
Smash your way out through the front in classic style. [1][10]

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Go bowling at that alley and finish a game — follow-through is the whole ask. It also counts toward trying the activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. [1][2]
Bowl a game and follow through. [1][10]

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This is a story-adjacent moment trophy tied to Jason and Lucia's partnership — it pops from a scene or beat about the pair's public profile. Play the story and the partner content around it; it unlocks on its own.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Play through the story and partner content with Jason and Lucia. [1][2]
This pops from a partnership beat — no separate grind. [1][10]

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. This trophy tracks choices you make across the game — PSN tracks a count up to 500. Keep playing, keep choosing, and the counter climbs. It is a long-tail trophy that fills in over a full playthrough and beyond.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Make choices as you play — the counter tracks them up to 500. [1][2]
Keep playing through story and side content; the count climbs over time. [1]

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Succeed at something on your second try — fail once, then come back and nail it. The exact trigger is a second-attempt success, so if you fail a challenge or attempt, retry it right away and finish it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Fail an attempt at a challenge or activity. [1][2]
Retry it immediately and succeed on the second try. [1][10]

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A hidden one-off for witnessing something strange in Leonida. Keep your eyes open while exploring — odd encounters and easter eggs are the usual trigger for a trophy with a description like this one.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Explore Leonida and watch for strange encounters. [1][2]
This pops from witnessing something unusual — keep exploring. [1][10]

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. While driving, lean out and knock someone down with a melee attack — a drive-by without a gun. Line up a slow pass, swing as you go by, and the trophy pops when the hit lands.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Get in a vehicle and find a target on foot. [1][2]
Perform a melee drive-by — knock them down with a melee attack from the vehicle. [1][10]

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — bank vaults, armored trucks and gang operations all pay in them — and your contacts wash them into clean cash. Keep robbing and laundering; the counter climbs with every batch you clean.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Earn Marked Bills from robberies (vaults, armored trucks, gang operations). [1][2]
Launder them through your contacts into clean cash. [1][6]
Repeat until $250,000 is laundered. [1]

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, vehicles, food and anything else the shops of Leonida sell — every dollar counts. This fills in naturally if you buy gear and garages as you play; if you are short at the end, spend the surplus on vehicles.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Spend across all shops — clothes, weapons, vehicles, food. [1][2]
Every dollar counts toward $100,000. [1][6]
Buy gear and garages as you play; top up with vehicles at the end. [1]

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought with clean cash and give you somewhere to store the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good. Buy them as you can afford them — all eight are needed.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Buy garage properties as you can afford them. [1][2]
Purchase all 8. [1][6]

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles around Leonida, open the Scooter Bros app, and register them — ten registrations pop the trophy. It pairs naturally with discovering vehicles for Whip It Good.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Find vehicles around Leonida. [1][2]
Register them in the Scooter Bros app — 10 registrations needed. [1][6]
